content.name: 27 g published-propulsion reference
content.notes: Reference experiment only: 27 g total matches CF2 datasheet; mass distribution, controller, battery dynamics and drag remain assumptions. No priced camera aircraft implied.

camera_height.note: Configured test resolution; not a measured camera pipeline.

camera_width.note: Configured test resolution; not a measured camera pipeline.

curve.note: 2015 four-motor table: thrust/4; (current-0.24 A)/4; effective voltage=PWM*V. Assumes motor symmetry and average-voltage equivalence. Clamp outside measured domain; no extrapolation. RPM column is published average.

content.name: D137 Micro 90
content.notes: Exploratory indoor design. Motor thrust and most masses unmeasured. Budget not recalculated after swaps.

camera_height.note: Configured test resolution; not a measured camera pipeline.

camera_width.note: Configured test resolution; not a measured camera pipeline.

resistance_ohm.note: 48 milliohm maximum at 2.5 V gate drive used as a conservative nominal-temperature value. PCB thermal and switching losses unmodelled.

gyro_noise_rad_s.note: Effective sampled noise hypothesis; datasheet density requires bandwidth/filter configuration.

prop_diameter_m.note: Matched propeller diameter listed by supplier; this does not validate the assumed thrust curve.
